hints.title: Initial Character Grouping
hints.text: Partition the suffixes of all words into 26 groups based on their first character.

hints.title: Valid Swap Condition
hints.text: For two initial letters a and b, words can swap first letters if neither suffix is shared by both letters.

hints.title: Set Intersection Size
hints.text: For each pair (i, j), count common suffixes c. The contribution is 2 * (len(group[i]) - c) * (len(group[j]) - c).

hints.title: Pairwise Suffix Intersection Implementation

complexity.notes: Comparing 26 * 25 / 2 pairs of sets is bounded by small constant alphabet factor.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs of words takes O(n^2 * L) which times out for n up to 50,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash sets store suffixes partitioned across 26 initial letters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes that swapping first letters is valid if and only if suffixes are mutually disjoint.
